For our shared overlap, I’m leaning m013 [1,3), then likely skip the crowded 2-6 overlap block except possibly a single short pick if needed, then m009 [7,9), then m001 [11,15). I probably won’t mirror m002 [3,4) because the broader group is converging on m014 [3,4)+m007 [4,6), but for coalition reward our strongest shared anchors seem m013, m009, m001. If you keep m002, that’s fine; I’ll avoid overlap penalties on my side.

I’ll likely skip the dense 2-6 block entirely rather than take m002, since group convergence is on m014+m007 and I’d rather avoid fragmenting. So my current intended chain is m013 [1,3), skip 2-6 meetings, m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15).

Taylor to Quinn (coalition) final planning update: I’m committing to m013 [1,3), m014 [3,4), m007 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15). This preserves our coalition overlaps on m013/m009/m001 with no self-overlap on my side, while also matching the broader group on m014/m007. (phase=planning, iter=1)
